    CHAPTER I

The measurements were first published in that year,[1] and the
results were at once disputed by several of his rivals abroad.

A second series was undertaken the following summer,[2] though
the weather was against the observers from beginning to end.

[Footnote 1: The second lecture of the Institute, delivered in May.]

    [Footnote 2: The charitable bequests made in that year alone
    came to a considerable sum, as the appendix shows in detail.]
